### 🤔 The Problem
Is this request stemming from a specific frustration or missing workflow? 
*Example: "It is tedious when a user forgets their physical NFC card, and I have no way to manually log their attendance on the same screen."*

***

### 📖 User Story (The Ideal Solution)

**👤 As a...**
> [Target user role: e.g., System Admin, Professor, Employee, App User]

**🎯 I want to...**
> [Describe the specific action or feature: e.g., have a 'Manual Override' button below the 'Ready to Scan' graphic to search a name and mark them present]

**🏆 In order to...**
> [The ultimate goal/value: e.g., easily log attendance for users who forgot their cards without interrupting the workflow]

***

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1 (e.g., An admin sees a 'Manual Override' button below the 'Ready to Scan' graphic.)
- [ ] Criterion 2 (e.g., Tapping the button opens a searchable list of active users.)
- [ ] Criterion 3 

### 📝 Technical Notes & Considerations
- [ ] Additional things to keep in mind (e.g., Ensure manual entries are tagged distinctly from NFC scans in the database for auditing purposes.)

### 🔀 Alternatives Considered
Have you thought of any other ways to solve this? (Workarounds, third-party tools, etc.)

### 📎 Extra Details
Add any rough mockups, diagrams, or additional context about this request here.
